O Lord, our Lord, how wondrous great
The glories of thy heavenly state
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 8, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens. 2From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger. 3When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place— 4what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him? … 5 more verses PSALM 8 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 8
O Lord, our Lord, how wondrous great Is thine exalted name! The glories of thy heavenly state Let men and babes proclaim. STANZA I
